idea-plugin.name: Simple SQL Query
idea-plugin.description:
A small, focused SQL console for PostgreSQL inside IntelliJ IDEA.

  • Connect to any PostgreSQL server with host, port, database, user, password and SSL mode.
  • Write SQL in an editor and run the statement at the caret with Ctrl+Enter, or the whole script with Ctrl+Shift+Enter.
  • Results appear in a sortable grid; multiple statements get one tab each, with rows affected and elapsed time per statement.
  • Auto-commit toggle plus explicit Commit / Rollback for transactional work.
  • Row fetch limit and per-statement timeout to keep accidental SELECT * on a huge table from freezing the IDE.
  • Copy cells, rows or the whole result set as tab separated text.
  • Saved connection profiles; passwords go to the IDE credential store, never to disk in plain text.

Works in IntelliJ IDEA Community Edition. If the IDE does not provide a PostgreSQL JDBC driver, point the connection profile at a postgresql-<version>.jar you downloaded.
